products.title: GP-Z1
products.body_html:
Our take on: A zero torque blade

Milled by Gambit.

Function:

A zero torque design in a sleek blade package. The shaft bore location is fine tuned for each lie and loft combination to ensure a true torsion-free design. Weighing in at 352 grams of 303 stainless steel, this putter will feel like a classic milled putter at contact with the benefit of modern zero torque technology making on line putts effortless. The laser engraved Z-grooves on the face ensure a softer feel while ensuring the ball rolls true right off the face.

Aesthetic:

The sexiest zero torque putter on the market. With a thinner profile, the shaft bore is close to the face, allowing for a natural setup relative to other zero torque models on the market. The dual sight lines on the top line naturally square the putter to the target.

Includes a premium stitched headcover.

*This putter is milled to order from a billet of 303 stainless steel by Gambit. Estimated lead time is 2-4 weeks to ship.

products.title: GP-W1
products.body_html:
Our take on: A center shaft wide blade

The first putter milled by Gambit.

Function:

A center shaft face balanced design with greater stability than a traditional blade. With a wide blade, the center of mass is shifted away from the face, providing high MOI while still getting the look and feel of a blade. This wide design provides the ease of alignment of a mallet, with the sleekness of a blade. The 352 gram center shaft design offers face stability like a zero torque putter, while still providing dynamic face feedback in the hands. The intricate face engraving has been optimized for performance and feel.

Aesthetic: 

A wide, modern blade with a nod to classic putter design. A clean, understated design that includes strategic mill patterns which create pleasing contrast over the ball. A bead blasted matte finish reduces glare for maximum performance. 

Includes a premium brown leather Gambit headcover. Customize yours below.

*This putter is milled to order from a billet of 303 stainless steel by Gambit. Estimated lead time is 2-4 weeks to ship.

products.body_html:

Function:

products.title: GP-M1 Black
products.body_html:
Our take on: A winged mallet

Function:

A face balanced mallet that confirms alignment and wants to stay on plane. The physics of this putter will fight against movement outside of your swing path with weight distribution maximizing MOI. Weights in the sole are removable for swing weight customization and positioned to keep the center of gravity towards the face of the club. Geometric features are designed to amplify the vision of your alignment. 

Aesthetic: 

Clean flowing lines, every effort to eliminate boxy, sharp features has been applied. High pass milling is used to achieve extremely smooth surfaces. Finished with a sleek black ceramic coating.

Aesthetic: 

Clean flowing lines, every effort to eliminate boxy, sharp features has been applied. High pass milling is used to achieve extremely smooth surfaces. Finished with a sleek black ceramic coating.
